general: Salary parameters are employee-specific values used in the salary calculation, such as fixed allowances, deviating bases or personal grants.
Below, the import template is described at column level, with sample data to make filling it in as easy as possible.

Medewerker.description: Employee number in AFAS. Must match the Medewerker column in the employees file.

Parameter.description: Numeric code of the salary parameter. Depends on the configuration — see the salary parameter master data in AFAS.

Begindatum.description: Start date of the parameter. Use the AFAS go-live date, for example 01-01-2026.

Einddatum.description: Leave empty for an ongoing grant. Fill in for temporarily granted values.

Waarde.description: The value: a numeric amount in euros or an indicator (J/N). The type depends on the parameter definition in AFAS.
